caption: Uploading a new avatar

Hover (.profile-pic) so the change button shows
click (button[aria-label="Change avatar"])
notes: The Change avatar window (scripts/apps/users/views/change-avatar.html, opened as activity modal with cssClass 'upload-avatar'). caption: Choosing how you get notifications
preconditions: Seed data loaded (tools/screenshots/seed.py): user marenholt (Maren Holt, Political Editor, role Editor, default desk Politics, password marenholt)

Best taken on a build that loads the markForUser extension and superdesk-planning, so the per-type checkboxes 'Send Mark for User notifications' and 'Send Assignment notifications' appear under the email switch. The stock e2e client loads neither, so the list is empty there.
steps: Open #/profile/ and wait for [data-test-id="user-details-form"] to be visible
wait for (h3#notifications) to be visible
notes: Section with 'Send notifications via email' switch, the per-type checkbox list (sd-email-notifications-list) and 'Allow Desktop Notifications' switch (scripts/apps/users/views/user-preferences.html). The section only renders after preferences load (preferencesLoaded).

caption: Monitoring in the dark theme
preconditions: Seed data loaded (tools/screenshots/seed.py): user marenholt (Maren Holt, Political Editor, role Editor, default desk Politics, password marenholt)
Seeded items exist in Politics desk stages
steps: Open #/profile/ and wait for [data-test-id="user-details-form"] to be visible
Open #/workspace/monitoring
select desk 'Politics'
wait until [data-test-id="monitoring-group"][data-test-value="Politics / Working"] contains at least one [data-test-id="article-item"]
notes: The theme is a server-side preference (application:theme), so it survives the per-shot reload: the cleanup switches marenholt back to Light. Run this shot last for the page. The theme radios are styled inputs; check them with force if needed. Saving applies the theme straight away (body data-theme). Saving preferences for a user without preferred categories asks 'No preferred categories selected ... A default set of categories will be selected for you.'; the steps answer OK (optional), which stores a default category set for marenholt.
